title: Chinh sach thu cung
question: Can ho co duoc nuoi cho meo khong?
answer: Vie c nuoi thu cung phu thuoc vao noi quy toa nha va chinh sach can ho. Khach can xem muc chinh sach thu cung va noi quy di kem can ho cu the.

title: Dat lich xem can
question: Toi muon dat lich xem can thi lam the nao?
answer: Khach co the de lai nhu cau trong khung chat hoac yeu cau xem nha de bo phan van hanh sap xep lich xem can phu hop.

title: Tien coc va gia thue
question: Tien coc va gia thue co bao gom phi dich vu khong?
answer: Gia thue co ban va tien coc duoc hien thi rieng. Cac khoan phi dich vu, tien ich hay noi dung bao gom can doi chieu voi thong tin cong khai cua can ho va chinh sach ap dung.

title: Noi quy gio yen tinh
question: Toa nha co quy dinh gio yen tinh khong?
answer: Co. Cu dan can tuan thu gio yen tinh va giu gin trat tu theo noi quy toa nha dang ap dung cho can ho.

title: Yeu cau bao tri
question: Khi can ho gap su co thi xu ly the nao?
answer: Nguoi dung can tao yeu cau bao tri hoac lien he bo phan ho tro. AI chi co the huong dan so bo, con lich xu ly cu the se do nhan su phu trach xac nhan.

title: Trang thai can ho
question: Trang thai cong khai cua can ho co y nghia gi?
answer: Trang thai cong khai cho biet can ho dang san sang cho thue, dang co nguoi o, dang bao tri hoac tam thoi khong kha dung.
